description: A React and TypeScript generative UI chat system with a Node API bridge to the Swarms multi-agent API.

questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed React development with safer component and API contracts.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Current repository language with minimal migration overhead.

questions.rationale: The request explicitly specifies React + TypeScript, while the current source is JSX.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and build setup should be used?

options.label: React with Vite
options.description: Retains the existing React/Vite structure and supports a fast generative UI workflow.

options.label: React with another build setup
options.description: Use a different React toolchain if required by the product.

questions.rationale: The repository already uses React and Vite.

questions.question: Which frontend capabilities should the generative UI include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Chat experience, streaming/loading states, generated UI rendering, responsive accessibility, and error handling
questions.answer: Chat experience, streaming/loading states, generated UI rendering, responsive accessibility, and error handling
questions.rationale: The current UI is a Swarms chat test and the request adds generative UI requirements.

questions.question: Which language should the backend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed server and provider contracts for the generative UI API.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Current Node server language with minimal migration overhead.

questions.rationale: The request specifies TypeScript, while server.mjs is currently JavaScript.

questions.question: Which backend framework and API style should be used?

options.label: Node.js HTTP API
options.description: Preserves the current lightweight server and /api/chat contract.

options.label: Express
options.description: Adds conventional routing and middleware for a larger API surface.

questions.rationale: The repository has a working Node HTTP bridge with a single chat endpoint.

questions.question: Which backend capabilities should be included?
questions.recommendedChoice: Swarms API integration, validated chat endpoint, provider error normalization, secret isolation, and generative UI payload support
questions.answer: Swarms API integration, validated chat endpoint, provider error normalization, secret isolation, and generative UI payload support
questions.rationale: Existing server.mjs proxies Swarms with server-side API key handling and response normalization.

sharedQuestions.question: Which data stores are required?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use the provider API and in-memory client state only.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Persist users, conversations, generated UI artifacts, or analytics.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Persist generated files or media assets.

sharedQuestions.rationale: The current application has no persistence layer; conversation state is local to the browser.

sharedQuestions.question: Should users sign in to use the application API features?

options.label: No
options.description: Keep the current anonymous local/test experience.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require users to sign in before using chat and generative UI features.

sharedQuestions.rationale: The current API bridge has no user identity or authorization flow.
